p: My dad is Mr. Agaba Ali.
My mum is Ananga Asha. She cares and loves so much.
Angela and Agatha play with toy cats and rabbits.
Apples are packed in a basket.
Namata, Cathy, Sara, Ali and Aba sat together.
Mummy taught me words with sound Aa
Asaba and Akello learnt about a train.
Sound Aaa i will never forget you.
